description: This file defines the JobTitleAPI class in the OrangeHRM system, which provides REST API endpoints for managing job titles within the HRM application. It includes methods for CRUD operations, validation rules, and handling job title data, including attachments.

classes.name: JobTitleAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class for managing Job Titles within the OrangeHRM HRM system, supporting CRUD operations, validation, and file attachments.

methods.name: getJobTitleService
methods.description: Returns an instance of JobTitleService, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific Job Title by ID. Throws RecordNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne method parameters.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all Job Titles with optional filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll method parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Job Title, including optional attachment handling.

methods.name: setJobTitle
methods.description: Maps request parameters to a JobTitle entity.

methods.name: setJobSpecification
methods.description: Attaches a base64-encoded file as a JobSpecificationAttachment to a JobTitle.

methods.name: getBase64JobSpecification
methods.description: Retrieves the base64 attachment from the request, if any.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for creating a Job Title.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Returns common validation rules for job title fields.

methods.name: getJobTitleCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Creates and returns an EntityUniquePropertyOption for ensuring unique jobTitleName.

methods.name: getSpecificationRule
methods.description: Validation rule for the specification file attachment.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Job Title, handling attachment and specifications.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules specifically for updating a Job Title.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more Job Titles by ID(s).
